key_news.headline: Intel CEO Announces GPU Production Plans
key_news.summary: Intel CEO Lip-Bu Tan announced that the company will start producing graphics processing units (GPUs) for gaming and AI model training tasks. The project will be overseen by Kevork Kechichian, executive VP and GM of Intel's data center group.

key_news.headline: Intel Core Ultra Series 3 Processors Launch
key_news.summary: Intel launched Core Ultra Series 3 processors at CES 2026, the first compute platform built on Intel 18A process. Available in over 200 designs from global partners, featuring up to 16 CPU cores, 12 Xe-cores and 50 NPU TOPS.

key_news.headline: Intel Stock Rally on AI Sector Momentum
key_news.summary: Intel stock recovering toward multi-year highs as entire AI semiconductor sector moves higher on massive cloud spending forecasts, including Amazon's $200B 2026 plan. Reports of Intel and AMD raising server CPU prices by 10% in China.

key_news.headline: Mixed Insider Trading Activity
key_news.summary: Intel CLO April Miller sold 20,000 shares for $981,000 proceeds, while CFO David Zinsner purchased 5,880 shares for $249,985 on January 27.
